message.content: Work in C:\Users\edmem\kodely-prod (a Next.js 16 + Prisma app called Kodely — an AI website builder). BUILD: a golden-set evaluation harness for generation quality. ## Why this exists Kodely's roadmap names "green-build-first-try" as a kill-criterion gating further work, but there is no way to tell whether a prompt change made generation better or worse. Every prompt tweak is currently a guess and regressions ship silently. This harness is the scoreboard. ## Scope — YOU MAY ONLY CREATE/EDIT FILES UNDER `scripts/eval/` Everything else in the repo is off limits. Other agents are working in parallel on other directories. You may READ anything to understand the system (especially lib/agent.ts, lib/agent-sdk.ts, lib/build-site.ts, lib/foundation.ts, app/api/generate/route.ts), but WRITE only under scripts/eval/. ## What to build 1. **A fixture set** of ~25-30 representative prompts as data (e.g. `scripts/eval/prompts.json` or a .ts module) covering the real spread of what people ask for: restaurant, SaaS landing page, portfolio, barber shop, event/wedding, gym, law firm, photographer, nonprofit, coming-soon page, personal blog, product launch, etc. Include a couple of deliberately awkward ones (very terse: "a website"; non-English; contradictory requirements) because those are where quality collapses. 2. **A runner** (`scripts/eval/run.mjs` or .mts) that for each prompt: - runs the real generation path (import `runAgent` from lib/agent.ts — it dispatches to whichever engine KODELY_ENGINE selects) - compiles the result with `buildSite` from lib/build-site.ts - records: compiled first try (bool), repair attempts, tokens, imputed cost, wall time, files written - writes a timestamped JSON result file under `scripts/eval/results/` - supports `--only ` to run a single fixture and `--concurrency N` (default low, e.g. 2 — these are expensive) 3. **Static scoring** of the generated output — cheap deterministic checks, no model call: - index.html has a real `` that is NOT the foundation's placeholder ("Kodely Site") - has a meta description of a sensible length - no placeholder text ("Lorem ipsum", "Your Title Here", "Coming soon" when not asked for) - no external requests (no `<script src="http`, `<link href="http`, `<img src="http`) — these break under the published CSP, so this is a correctness check not a style one - some responsive signal (media queries or Tailwind breakpoint classes present) - component count > 1 (not one giant App.tsx) Each check pass/fail, plus an overall score. 4. **A comparison/report command** (`scripts/eval/report.mjs`) that diffs two result files and prints what got better and what got worse per-fixture and in aggregate — that is the actual point of the harness. ## Critical constraints - DO NOT modify: prisma/schema.prisma, lib/credits.ts, lib/agent.ts, lib/agent-sdk.ts, lib/build-site.ts, lib/events.ts, lib/build-narration.ts, app/api/generate/route.ts, app/projects/[id]/Editor.tsx, app/globals.css, proxy.ts, deploy.sh, .env, package.json. - DO NOT run `npm run build`, `git commit`, `git push`, or `deploy.sh`. - DO NOT add npm dependencies. Node 24 built-ins only. - The harness must NOT write to the application database. It runs generation in-process and holds results in memory/files. runAgent takes `onWrite`/`onDelete` callbacks — implement them against an in-memory FileMap, do not touch Prisma. - `KODELY_FOUNDATION_DIR` must be set for buildSite to work (it is in .env: C:\Users\edmem\kodely-foundation). Load .env yourself (`node -r dotenv/config` or read it) — this bit me earlier: without it the foundation path defaults to a Linux path and every build fails with a misleading "Cannot find module". - Each generation costs real tokens. DO NOT run the full suite. Verify your harness end-to-end on ONE fixture at most, and say clearly in your report how you verified and what you did not. ## Report back Files created, how to run it, what you verified vs. assumed, and any place where you had to guess at the scoring rubric.

Report: `--all`, `--json`, `--fail-on-regression` (exit 1, for CI). **Cost guardrail:** the runner refuses to start on more than 5 fixtures without `--yes`.
